name: CR-Diff-02-linearity-4.e
questiontext:
Expand the following expresion and differentiate it with respect to {{CT:0}}:\[ \frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}}. \]

 [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
In order to solve this problem we will have to use the linearity rules for differentition. <hint>calc_diff_linearity_rule</hint>

 Since
 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 \frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \frac{1}{{CT:2}}-\frac{{CT:3}}{{CT:2}} \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:4}}
  \end{array}\]

 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 \frac{d}{d{{CT:5}}}\left[\frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}}\right]  &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \frac{d}{d{{CT:5}}}\left( {{CT:4}}\right)  \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \frac{d}{d{{CT:5}}}\left({{CT:6}}\right) - \frac{d}{d{{CT:5}}}\left( {{CT:7}}\right) \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:8}}
  \end{array}\]
